Six recipes: Pitch Shark (hero), Job Interviewer, Language Tutor, Brand Mascot, Debate Partner, Standup Roast. Lead with Pitch Shark.
Pitch Shark: Shawn Therapist 7b888024-f8c9-4205-95e1-78ce01497bda + Shawn IA 51afbab6-7af4-473b-95fc-6ce26aac8bb1; live embeds only.
LiveAvatar via api.liveavatar.com with X-API-KEY and browser User-Agent. Collect LIVEAVATAR_API_KEY via secure secret. Never put keys in share templates.
